finding_key: packages/notes/src/view/preview.test.ts::no test for the top-level lone-dash case (`text\n-`), the broadest behavior change of the lheading rewrite
evidence:
The added tests in preview.test.ts (lines ~151-195) cover exactly five cases: `- 1
  -`, `- 1
  - `, `- 1

  - `, `Heading
---`, and `- 1
  - 2` — none of them a top-level lone `-` (e.g. `Heading
-`). Meanwhile list-empty-bullet-plugin.ts's `isLoneDash = marker === DASH && runLength === 1` has no indent/list-context condition, so an ordinary top-level setext h2 written with a single dash stops being a heading everywhere in the notes preview; the wrapped `list` rule (silent + parentType==='paragraph' + empty bullet) will also terminate the paragraph at top level, so the output shape genuinely changes and is unpinned. The PR's own task doc in this diff lists "top-level lone dash" among the intended unit tests, confirming the gap is an omission rather than a deliberate scoping choice.
